method: Direct inspection of each original six-view Vulkan sheet and generated concept reference. No image retouching or similarity-score claims.

objects.observed: Hooded skull, layered worn armor, ragged dark cloak, idle sword and physical closed boot soles are visible across six views.
objects.residual_difference: Runtime armor panels and cloth folds are broader and simpler than the concept; layered engraving and fine cloth fraying remain approximate.

objects.observed: The actual anatomical skeleton is intact in every view, with no clipping or missing bones.
objects.residual_difference: Mustard bone tint exceeds the neutral aged-ivory concept. Root has requested a local palette correction before final02.

objects.observed: The actual closed coal core uses the generated coal map with sparse irregular orange fissures; animated tongues and embers are visible.
objects.residual_difference: Concept has broader fractured coal lobes and more turbulent fine flame wisps; runtime uses bounded low-cost tongues and textured relief.

objects.observed: The dark fluid core, smooth ellipsoid normals, Fresnel edges and peripheral droplets are visible; prior horizontal facet banding is removed.
objects.residual_difference: Concept fluid wrinkles and turbulent reflections are finer and stronger; runtime retains a smoother fluid envelope.

objects.observed: Pointed blue frosted splinter has closed geometry in all directions, including the formerly culled shoulder facets.
objects.residual_difference: Concept has deeper crystalline fractures and chipped frost detail; the runtime silhouette preserves the production projectile axis rather than the concept sheet's inconsistent view orientation.

objects.observed: The non-emissive irregular stone is fully closed and visibly stone-textured in every direction.
objects.residual_difference: Concept cracks and fractured relief are sharper; the runtime uses a lower-polygon stone with broader facets.

objects.observed: A dim folded hood and ragged tapered shroud replace the primitive body; six views show a complete noncombat visual with the original fade envelope.
objects.residual_difference: The runtime shroud has broad bent folds and a much dimmer silhouette; fine smoky threads and the concept's more distinct hood cavity remain approximate.

objects.observed: Nine real wood planks, muted painted rings, rear braces and attached fasteners are visible across all six views. Paint follows plank gaps without the previous barcode wear artifact.
objects.residual_difference: Concept wood splintering and paint flecks are finer; the runtime keeps exact original target footprint and ring hit layout.

objects.observed: Thin stone training pad has muted cornered inlay on its top and an unobstructed stone underside; original dimensions and positions remain unchanged.
objects.residual_difference: Concept stone chips and worn edging are richer; thin edge views are necessarily only a narrow line at the unchanged production thickness.
